reference: Previously approved 01-heraldry warrior/archer concept sheets, generated locally in this conversation.
body:
Production transparent sprite atlas for the existing medieval strategy game. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES: match exactly their original HERALDIC GRAPHIC style, proportions and facial drawing, deep navy outlines, bold large flat planes, 3-tone material shading, no realistic detail. Create SEVEN different armless infantry BUSTS, each from waist belt to helmet, NO ARMS NO HANDS NO LEGS, no weapon. All belong to Myadel Dominion: dull ochre gold #AD883A main cloth and charcoal #343329 contrast, subdued steel and cream. NOT red and cream from reference. Distinct ordinary male faces.
STRICT GRID: square image, 3 equal columns and 3 equal rows. ONE isolated centered bust in each cell, with generous transparent gaps. Fill these cells in reading order:
top left d1 militia: padded gambeson ochre/charcoal, simple brown skullcap, small round ochre/black shield already on lower LEFT chest.
top center d2 shieldman: steel kettle-brim helmet, slate chainmail shoulder collar drawn simply, ochre tabard and black central band, ochre/charcoal kite shield already at lower LEFT chest.
top right d3 dominion guard: CLOSED steel greathelm with narrow eye slit, mail collar, ochre/charcoal tabard with broad black vertical stripe, larger ochre kite shield with bold black central stripe and simple gold oak motif already on lower LEFT chest.
middle left d2s spearman: steel nasal helmet like input warrior, padded ochre gambeson, charcoal scarf, small round ochre/charcoal shield on lower LEFT chest.
middle center d3s halberdier: steel kettle helmet, grey mail and ochre shoulder/tabard cloth, leather belt, NO shield.
middle right d2x crossbowman: steel nasal helmet, charcoal padded gambeson with broad ochre vertical cloth panel, small bolt quiver at back LEFT, NO shield.
bottom left d3x forest marksman: steel kettle helmet, simple mail collar and ochre/charcoal tunic, dark muted green short shoulder cloak, small bolt quiver at back LEFT, NO shield.
bottom center and bottom right cells MUST BE EMPTY TRANSPARENT.
All busts same width and HEIGHT within their cell, baseline aligned. Heads near cell top; bodies around lower half. No ground, no oval bases, no shadows, no numbers, no text, no cell outlines. Head and body fully connected at neck, shields belong to body layer. Single clean sprite per occupied cell.
Preserve input's angular lively but not angry faces, restrained strong graphic visual language, economical broad cloth folds, no photorealism or glossy 3D. This is actual game production material to crop into an atlas and animate with separate weapon layer. Transparent background essential. Each bust must fit completely within its cell.
weapons:
Production sprite asset sheet, transparent background, same clean HERALDIC GRAPHIC art style as the reference weapons: navy outlines, broad cel-shaded steel, restrained dull brass, dark brown wood, no realistic texture.
STRICT layout TWO columns and THREE rows, each isolated object fully inside its equal cell with wide transparent gaps. No labels, no frames, no shadows.
TOP LEFT: straight medieval one-handed sword, blade pointing straight UP, long blade, small brass crossguard, charcoal leather grip and small pommel. Like reference sword, muted material colors.
TOP RIGHT: simple one-handed woodman's battle axe, vertical shaft, steel head at top pointing right, dark brown wood handle, blade large and readable.
MIDDLE LEFT: upright long spear, narrow leaf steel point at top, dark wooden shaft.
MIDDLE RIGHT: upright halberd, steel axe-blade on right near upper end, simple spear tip at top, small hook left, long wooden shaft.
BOTTOM LEFT: single medieval wooden CROSSBOW viewed front in three-quarter game-icon orientation, stock runs HORIZONTALLY toward the RIGHT, prod spans VERTICALLY at the RIGHT end, taut string forms clean triangle to a central nut, short quarrel points RIGHT along the top of the stock, charcoal binding and dull steel hardware, wood brown. Compact readable medieval crossbow, NOT a longbow, NOT gun-like. No hands or arms.
BOTTOM RIGHT: EMPTY transparent.
For sword and axe grip should be near lower third; spear and halberd shaft extend near bottom. Do NOT include hands (game renders the weapon independently). Each weapon one cohesive cutout, no duplicates. No extra ornaments. Keep line/shading detail economical so objects read at 15-40px. Actual game assets.
assembly: render_heraldic_faction.cjs dominion: crop/resize/pack, no runtime model generation.
